claims.text: What it = good for US finds superfic growths and foreign bodies, incl in the limbs
claims.quote: Ultrasound can identify superficial growths and foreign bodies (eg, in the thyroid gland, breasts, testes, limbs, and some lymph nodes).
Musculoskeletal: To evaluate muscles, tendons, and nerves

claims.text: Abscess or cellulitis? POCUS helps tell an abscess from cellulitis when the exam = unclear
claims.quote: Point-of-care ultrasound can improve diagnostic accuracy and help distinguish an abscess from cellulitis when there is diagnostic uncertainty

claims.text: Abscesses are found mainly by exam (focal tenderness, fluctuance); imaging can separate cellulitis from abscess (such as US) or from necrotizing infect (such as MRI)
claims.quote: Abscesses should be identified primarily through clinical evaluation (eg, focal tenderness, fluctuance). Imaging modalities can effectively distinguish between cellulitis and abscess (eg, point of care ultrasound) or necrotizing soft-tissue infection (eg, MRI)
